plates.name: winners
plates.master: The client's photo (1280 x 960), upscaled 2x with Lanczos and lifted by the design team. It is kept as tools/masters/winners-graded.jpg (quality 96). Do not swap in an AI upscale: one changed the B of Best speaker into a D. When the master is made again, use less clarity and output sharpening: this one leaves a faint light rim along dark edges against the whiteboard, seen only zoomed in on a phone.
